summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The First Trust SMID Capital Strength ETF (FSCS) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the The SMID Capital Strength index. The fund tracks an equal-weighted index of 100 well-capitalized small- and mid-cap US companies perceived to hold strong market positions. FSCS was launched on Jun 20, 2017 and is issued by First Trust.

holdings.infoBox: FSCS is an equity ETF with a total of 101 individual holdings. The top holdings are Halozyme Therapeutics stock at 1.50%, MarketAxess Holdings at 1.49%, Nordson at 1.19%, Ulta Beauty at 1.18%, and Allegion at 1.17%.
